baseline_models.focus_anchor: The active plural label at focus word 3 and the recipient construction in the focus clause.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus label need not denote people who merely utter lies. Its strongest branch makes them agents who assign falsehood to a report, truth, or bearer; the clause allocates woe to that continuing adjudicative posture while leaving its object unstated.

activation_trace.role: Declaring a thing or its bearer false supplies the literal attribution act and makes active adverse classification the focus mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Woe that day to liars in a generic sense.
changed_reading.after: Woe is assigned to those who actively pronounce a truth-bearing claim or bearer false.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus participle at word 3, read through a branch in which truth or falsity is tested by follow-through.
baseline_models.mechanism: A charge proves true when carried through and proves false when it breaks off. This lets the focus label carry a performative edge: the deniers are implicated in a stance whose truth-claim will fail under enactment, not only in defective speech.

activation_trace.role: A charge fulfilled or failed supplies a performance test and recasts denial as a position that may not hold when carried into action.

changed_reading.before: The deniers make a wrong verbal assertion.
changed_reading.after: The deniers inhabit a counter-claim whose conduct or outcome may expose it as unfulfilled.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus root at word 3 and its branch for an appearance that lies by its condition.
baseline_models.mechanism: The patterned-cloth branch permits a material analogy in which falsity is carried by a displayed condition rather than a sentence. The participial class can therefore include people whose visible arrangement presents a misleading surface.

activation_trace.role: A variegated cloth whose condition deceives supplies the surface image and opens a nonverbal mode of falsification.

changed_reading.before: Denial occurs only in an explicit proposition.
changed_reading.after: A person or social display can deny by presenting a surface that misstates its real condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening exchange pairs full acquisition for oneself with imposed deficiency for others. Against the focus branch that tests whether a charge is carried through, this asymmetry becomes enacted falsification: the actors rely on a norm of full equivalence when receiving and make that same norm fail when giving.

activation_trace.role: A charge proving true or false through follow-through supplies the focus-side test that the transaction fails.
Comparison between two matters supplies the paired-account image and makes receipt and delivery answer to one another.
Completion without deficiency marks the standard secured on the receiving side and exposes its selective application.
The balance of justice supplies the reciprocal norm whose distortion turns conduct into a false counterstatement.
Making measure or weight deficient supplies the concrete failure by which the professed exchange standard is falsified.

structural_cues: 83:1 supplies the opening agent-label and its branchless ط ف ف root only as a structural cue; no branch identity is inferred for it.
83:2-3 reverse the same commercial relation between receiving and giving, making asymmetry rather than isolated shortage the operative pattern.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired measuring, full receipt, just balance, and imposed deficiency; I infer the arrow from selective reciprocity to conduct that falsifies its own norm. A live alternative is that the opening only specifies injustice and does not modify the semantics of denial.

changed_reading.before: The focus condemns people for verbally calling truth false.
changed_reading.after: It also catches those whose asymmetric dealing performs a counter-truth: they invoke exactness for themselves while making exactness fail for others.

context_deltas.mechanism: A distrusted outcome becomes the stirring of what was still, then a severe event in which people stand before sovereignty. The focus performance branch turns that sequence into an evidentiary reversal: the claim they treated as failing is made to stand, while their counter-claim fails at the very event named by the deictic day.

activation_trace.role: Whether a charge carries through supplies the focus test whose result is reversed by the standing scene.
An outcome not trusted supplies the deniers' unstable forecast and the epistemic starting point of the reversal.
Stirring the still from rest supplies the transition that makes the denied event operative.
A day's event and severity turns the temporal marker into a happening that verifies rather than merely dates.
Awe before magnitude supplies the pressure under which the rival truth-claims can no longer remain abstract.
Resurrection and the standing of the Hour supply the literal realization of the claim being made to stand.
Sovereignty and mastery supply the authority before which the evidentiary standing has consequence.

structural_cues: 83:4 asks about being raised, 83:5 names the event, and 83:6 stages bodily standing; the sequence converts supposition into realization.
The focus expression 'that day' compresses this immediately preceding proof sequence into its temporal pointer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies uncertain expectation, arousal from stillness, the severe day, and standing before mastery; I infer that realization makes one claim stand and the rival claim fail. Alternatively, the scene may only identify when punishment occurs, without activating the failed-charge branch.

changed_reading.before: That day is merely the future date on which deniers are punished.
changed_reading.after: That day is the proof-event in which the denied claim is made to stand and the deniers' counter-claim is made to fail.

context_deltas.mechanism: The active classifiers of the focus are surrounded by a mirrored system of entry, confinement, and visible inscription. Their act of assigning falsity is therefore answered by a prior or higher classification that enters actors into durable registers; the adverse labeler becomes the labeled and recorded party.

activation_trace.role: Assigning falsity to a thing or bearer supplies the human classificatory act that the registers answer.
Entering a name into a register or class supplies the first durable counter-classification of the classifiers.
Confinement in a holding place gives the first record spatial finality rather than leaving it a loose allegation.
A marked line in a book or register supplies inspectable inscription and counters an unsupported declaration of falsity.
A second entry into a register supplies the matching upper classification and reveals a two-sided archival order.
The repeated marked register supplies documentary symmetry and strengthens the reversal from labeler to recorded subject.

structural_cues: 83:7-9 and 83:18-20 form lower and upper panels that repeat the same two-word record formula around the focus.
The focus stands immediately after the first marked record, so its active human verdict is heard against an already established archive.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two class-registers, visible marking, and confinement; I infer a reversal from people who classify truth as false to people classified by a durable record. The live alternative is that the registers document consequences without semantically answering the focus label.

changed_reading.before: The deniers exercise the decisive verdict by labeling a claim false.
changed_reading.after: Their verdict is nested inside a documentary order that records and classifies the classifiers themselves.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context first names recompense as the denied object, then enacts denial as a genre-and-time operation. Successive signs carrying visible marks are met with speech that files them as old false lines. The denier neutralizes a present address by relocating it into a safely finished past.

activation_trace.role: Declaring a thing false supplies the focus act that the following verses display in operation.
The repeated act of assigning falsity carries the focus label into a clause that now exposes its object.
Accounting and returning recompense supply the denied claim's concrete judicial content.
Following in succession supplies a live unfolding address rather than a dead residue from the past.
A manifest sign supplies present evidence that must be actively reclassified to be dismissed.
Saying what was not or attributing it supplies the verbal operation by which the evidence receives a false genre label.
False legendary lines supply the dismissive genre into which the present signs are placed.
Priority and temporal precedence supply the pastward displacement that removes the address from the present.

structural_cues: 83:11 supplies the previously unstated object of denial, while 83:13 supplies a miniature scene of how denial is performed.
The when-clause links receipt of signs directly to the answering label, making reclassification a response rather than an independent opinion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recompense, sequential recitation, manifest signs, speech, false lines, and precedence; I infer that the response disables present force by moving the address into an obsolete genre and time. It may alternatively be a simple content accusation with no strategic temporal function.

changed_reading.before: A denier simply rejects the truth value of a future judgment.
changed_reading.after: A denier manufactures distance by recoding a present, marked address as old narrative and thereby evading its current claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's deceptive surface turns inward. Repeated acquisition produces an inescapable coating over the heart, turns perception away from its proper face, and becomes a barrier to access; the later spoken demonstrative confronts the perceiver with what this acquired surface had made appear false.

activation_trace.role: A cloth whose displayed condition deceives supplies the material surface that context relocates onto perception.
An enveloping condition with no exit supplies the coating's trapping force rather than a momentary mistake.
Turning a thing from its face supplies the perceptual inversion by which truth can come to look false.
Acquiring sought gain supplies the repeated input from the actors themselves that accumulates into the coating.
A screening barrier supplies the mature state of the acquired surface: blocked access rather than mere disagreement.
A thing's own indication supplies the final counter-display when the denied object is pointed out as self-showing.
The repeated attribution of falsehood identifies the earlier perceptual inversion as the practice named by the focus.

structural_cues: 83:14 corrects the preceding explanation and grammatically places what they acquired against the coating on their hearts.
83:15 moves from internal coating to blocked access, while 83:17 ends with a demonstrative confrontation with the denied object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acquired action, trapping coating, turned heart, barrier, and later indication; I infer a feedback arrow in which conduct patterns perception until truth appears false. An alternative keeps these as punishment or symptom after an independently chosen denial.

changed_reading.before: A deceptive surface is an outward presentation used to mislead others.
changed_reading.after: Acquired conduct can pattern the perceiver's own inner surface, recursively producing the appearance of falsity that sustains denial.

context_deltas.mechanism: The upper sequence develops the opposite of a failed charge: truth carries word and deed through, is witnessed, becomes recognizable and radiant on faces, and arrives as secured provision with scent and source. Denial is thus opposition to a claim that keeps verifying itself in documentary, social, visual, and material media.

activation_trace.role: A charge that proves true by being carried through supplies the focus-side criterion answered by the reward sequence.
Truth that carries speech and action through supplies the direct positive counterpart to failed performance.
Presence with observation supplies public verification rather than a private counter-assertion.
The answer of yes and affirmation latent in the bliss-root supplies an audible counter-pole to denial within the same scene.
Recognition by an effect or mark supplies an inferential route from visible consequence back to the truth of the promise.
Radiant freshness supplies the face as a legible medium on which fulfillment appears.
A secured preventing seal supplies preservation and delivery integrity to the promised provision.
Musk fragrance supplies a sensory trace by which fulfillment exceeds the visual and written channels.
A flowing spring supplies an originating source, completing the movement from recorded promise to material availability.

structural_cues: 83:18-28 moves from upper record to witnesses, faces, sealed drink, scent, mixture, and spring, progressively changing the medium of verification.
The positive sequence follows the repeated marked-record panel, so sensory fulfillment extends rather than replaces documentary proof.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies carried-through truth, witness, recognizable marks, radiance, a secured drink, scent, and source; I infer that these are converging verification channels for what was denied. They may instead be reward details whose contrast does not define denial itself.

changed_reading.before: The deniers oppose a claim whose truth remains abstract until judgment.
changed_reading.after: They oppose a truth that carries through and becomes independently legible in record, witness, face, scent, and provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final scene socializes the focus act. One group passes, watches, jokes about reputations, and issues a verdict that the believers are lost, despite lacking any commission to guard them. The gaze and laughter then reverse, and recompense returns enacted work to its doers; the denier is an unauthorized classifier caught inside a reversible tribunal.

activation_trace.role: Declaring a person or claim false supplies the focus verdict that the social scene expands into collective policing.
Offense and culpable injury supply the context's judgment on the group that presumes to judge another.
Trusting assent supplies the rival posture and identifies the people made into objects of ridicule.
An object made laughable supplies the first social sanction attached to the false verdict.
Passing and traversing supplies the encounter through which observation is converted into peer performance.
Turning away and returning supplies the transport of the verdict from encounter into the group's home circle.
Making entertainment from reputations supplies the mechanism by which classification becomes socially pleasurable.
Sight by eye or insight supplies the evidentiary pretense from which the observers issue their verdict.
Passing judgment upon another supplies the precise speech-act that converts seeing into unauthorized classification.
Departure from guidance and intended course supplies the adverse class assigned to the believers.
Sending and commissioning supplies the absent authorization explicitly denied to the observers.
Guarding and supervision supplies the office they were not given, exposing their verdict as jurisdictionally empty.
Veiling truth supplies the later class-name's epistemic link to the focus act of declaring truth false.
The repeated object of laughter supplies a role reversal in which the earlier social sanction changes direction.
Recompense returning an act to its worker supplies the causal return of the classifiers' own practice.
Bringing an action into being supplies the enacted material that returns, so judgment answers what was done as well as said.

structural_cues: 83:29 and 83:34 reverse the subject and object of laughter, while 83:23 and 83:35 repeat the seated looking scene on the other side.
83:30 includes branchless غ م ز only as a structural cue for covert peer signaling; no mapped root or branch is inferred.
83:33 interrupts the mockers' verdict with a jurisdictional negation, and 83:36 closes by asking whether enacted work has returned to its agents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies passing, ridicule, home-group amusement, seeing, a spoken verdict of error, absent guardianship, reversed looking and laughter, and returned recompense; I infer a social tribunal whose unauthorized verdict rebounds. Mockery could instead be only a symptom of denial, and the reversal only recompense, without redefining the focus label.

changed_reading.before: The deniers are private holders of a false belief about a proposition.
changed_reading.after: They are unauthorized social classifiers who turn observation into reputational judgment, then undergo a reversal in which their verdict and enacted sanction return upon them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the focus root's branch for milk disappearing after an expectation of continuance, not the ordinary sense of active denial. It remains anchored in focus word 3 and gains a coherent material counter-sequence from secured, held, sourced drink. Downstream prose should call it a supply-failure analogy, never a lexical translation of the focus participle.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 3 through the branch in which an expected supply fails to last.

activation_trace.role: Milk vanishing or failing to last as expected supplies the focus-side image of a promise treated as unreliable supply.
A secured seal supplies the opposite image of provision protected against loss or disappearance.
A place that holds water or keeps it stable supplies material retention against the focus branch's failed duration.
A running spring supplies continuing source-flow and completes the inversion of disappearing supply.
Taking in liquid supplies realized consumption, moving the promised provision from expectation to receipt.

changed_reading.before: The focus concerns only a proposition judged false.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, denial treats promised provision as a supply expected to vanish, while the context answers with preservation, source, and actual receipt.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the focus form does not ordinarily name an animal that runs, halts, and looks behind. It remains anchored in the focus root and is unusually reactivated by the late sequence of passing, returning, seeing, and reciprocal looking. Downstream prose should preserve it only as a kinetic branch-echo for socially suspicious surveillance, not as a replacement gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 3 through the branch of forward motion interrupted by a backward look.

activation_trace.role: A wild animal running, stopping, and looking behind supplies the kinetic pattern of interrupted motion and backward scrutiny.
Passing onward supplies the initial forward motion that the social glance interrupts.
Turning away and returning supplies reversal of direction and carries the encounter back into the home group.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies the scrutinizing look that converts halted movement into judgment.
Things facing one another so each can be seen supplies the final reciprocal gaze and reversal of watcher and watched.

changed_reading.before: Denial is a static intellectual position.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is a stop-and-look-back posture: social motion is arrested by suspicious scrutiny, then the gaze itself is reversed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus grammar names a plural human class, while the activated branch explicitly applies the root-label to the soul. It remains anchored in focus word 3 and is reinforced by the heart and competing-souls cues. Downstream prose should carry it as an intrapersonal echo within persons, not erase the focus's communal and social referent.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 3 through the branch that names the soul with the root's intensive descriptor.

activation_trace.role: The soul explicitly called by the root's intensive descriptor supplies an interior agent alongside the outward social class.
The heart as inward faculty supplies the site in which the denying posture can become internally lodged.
A precious object over which souls compete supplies an inner counter-movement to the denying self.
The life-bearing soul supplies the literal interior subject in which denial and aspiration can coexist.

changed_reading.before: The focus points only to a fixed external outgroup called deniers.
changed_reading.after: Alongside that social referent, the focus can echo an interior denying self whose acquired coating competes with the soul's capacity to seek what is precious.

strongest_changes: The measuring sequence turns denial from defective speech into enacted falsification of a reciprocity norm.
The raising-and-standing sequence turns 'that day' into a proof-event where the denied claim stands and its rival fails.
The mirrored records answer human adverse classification by registering the classifiers themselves.
The final gaze, verdict, absent commission, and returned recompense recast denial as unauthorized social judgment that reverses upon its agents.
summary.what_was_special: The single focus participle sustained coexisting transactional, evidentiary, documentary, perceptual, sensory, social, and interior readings. Especially productive were branches where truth is tested by follow-through, appearance lies by condition, expected supply fails, motion halts for a backward look, and the soul itself bears the root-label.
remaining_uncertainties: The attribution branch is morphologically close to the focus form; the performance, cloth, milk, animal-motion, and soul branches are analogical activations and must not be promoted to replacement glosses.
The records, coating, and reward media may explain the structure and consequences of denial without all belonging to its lexical mechanism.
The focus alone leaves the denied object unstated; the following context strongly identifies recompense and judgment, but the broader active-classifier reading remains live.
